subject: Lane E HANDOFF: fail-closed P0 regression-safety gate for first-open fixes
body: Bounded Lane E audit is complete on unchanged live main 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1 and successful Beta2 CI run 37091317521. Current CI is meaningful but insufficient as a P0 acceptance oracle: it verifies the expected Beta1 source baseline, reapplies the validated Shizuku/onboarding predecessor, checks/applies the Beta2 patch, runs testFullDebugUnitTest, builds the full debug APK and uploads evidence; however the workflow/build record explicitly leaves physical Fold7 validation NOT_RUN. Deterministic preservation coverage is strongest for stale authority/fencing, host remap and capture ordering, cover power/brightness policy mathematics and rotation geometry. Fold7PanelAuthorityGen4Test rejects stale intent/service epochs, requires cleanup across service rollover, keeps failed release retryable, and fuzzes 100,000 randomized authority operations. Fold7CoverVisualAttemptOwnerGen3Test preserves visible demand across host remap and rejects old-host callbacks; Fold7ContinuityFrameStoreGen3OrderingTest rejects older capture publication after a newer capture starts. Beta2-specific CoverPresentationPolicy tests cover fully-open OFF, close wake at 175deg/minimum brightness, brightness match by 90deg, and opening OFF at 177deg; DisplayTransform tests cover physical right-pane geometry for 0/90/180/270 plus scaled capture. The service-pack report explicitly says hidden Samsung brightness behavior, physical panel wake, live-content cadence, rotation during active fold, and 175/177 hysteresis remain NOT_RUN on device. Privacy/security and 120Hz remain mandatory contracts but this audit found no Beta2-specific evidence establishing contract-level protected-pixel short-circuit/provenance or requested-vs-actual refresh acquire/observe/release semantics; do not infer them from the generic full-unit-suite PASS. Current Lane B has corrected the invalid-display synchronous-throw sub-hypothesis and now identifies recovered COVER_PREWARMING/COVER_READY_HIDDEN/COVER_VISUAL -> OPENING_FROM_CLOSED concurrency with HideMirror + ReleaseSecondary + WakeInner + gen3 beginOpening as a stronger SOURCE-backed candidate, still unproven without a stack/death trace. Lane D's current causal-proof handoff requires exact first-open/current-build identity, cache MISS/HIT branch, privileged capture ENTER/RETURN/CALLBACK, display lifecycle, process/service death and FIRST_USEFUL_PRESENTATION receipts. Therefore every A-D fix should be rejected/deferred unless it passes the deterministic preservation matrix below and then survives current-build Fold7 field validation for field-only properties. No production writes performed by Research.

gate_matrix.invariant: stale generation/service/display mutations cannot regain authority; cleanup/release remains retryable
gate_matrix.required_for_p0_fix: retain/rerun full unit suite; add fix-specific stale-before-and-after-privileged-call case where touched

guards: Fold7CoverVisualAttemptOwnerGen3Test host remap rejects old callback

gate_matrix.field_gap: Samsung/SurfaceControl physical brightness and 175/177 hysteresis NOT_RUN
gate_matrix.required_for_p0_fix: unit tests plus physical Fold7 close/open brightness validation

gate_matrix.invariant: rotation/remap preserves physical right-pane geometry and current host ownership
gate_matrix.required_for_p0_fix: unit tests plus physical active-fold rotation/remap validation

gate_matrix.field_gap: actual cadence/smoothness and repeated current-build first/later open sequence require device evidence

guards: Beta2 patch enables Fold7 live recapture
gate_matrix.field_gap: Beta2 live-content cadence NOT_RUN on device
gate_matrix.required_for_p0_fix: current-build moving-content fold/close/open field test and exact-current capture receipts

gate_matrix.invariant: PRIVATE_FROST > VIDEO_PASSTHROUGH > PUBLIC_GLASS; protected/private/unknown content never materializes protected pixels
gate_matrix.field_gap: FLAG_SECURE/work-profile/privacy transitions require explicit field gates; contract-level short-circuit not established by inspected Beta2-specific tests
gate_matrix.required_for_p0_fix: no P0 change may bypass provenance/capture fences; retain/add explicit security tests and run secure/private field gates if capture path changes

gate_matrix.invariant: 120Hz is requested only when safe, actual cadence measured, fallback correct, lease released at terminal/supersession
gate_matrix.field_gap: actual delivered cadence is hardware/runtime evidence
gate_matrix.required_for_p0_fix: explicit acquire/request/observe/release assertions where presentation path changes plus device requested-vs-actual telemetry; 60Hz fallback must remain correct

gate_matrix.invariant: same attempt spans cover->inner route/presentation and useful presentation is not inferred from physical wake
gate_matrix.field_gap: FIRST_USEFUL on current INNER display for first-open attempt not yet captured
gate_matrix.required_for_p0_fix: consume Lane C readiness and Lane D trace outputs; require exact-current FIRST_USEFUL_PRESENTATION before retiring bridge/declaring success

fail_closed_promotion_rule: Do not accept a P0 fix because first-open no longer crashes in a model or because CI is green.
Require current-head deterministic tests to preserve all touched invariants.

Require current Beta2-or-successor Fold7 field proof for physical wake, first-useful presentation, repeated later-open smoothness, close path, active-fold rotation, live-content cadence and cover brightness behavior.
If capture/render/privacy path changes, require explicit privacy provenance/secure-content regression proof.
If presentation/refresh path changes, require requested-vs-actual cadence and terminal release proof with safe 60Hz fallback.
No promotion while the first-open crash lacks a current-build causal trace unless the proposed change has an independently decisive causal proof and field falsification.
